name: tartaria-desktop
description: Electron + Steam desktop wrapper for Tartaria Realms. Loads the Expo web export (react-native-web) and adds Steamworks (achievements/overlay). Separate npm package from the mobile app so it never affects the RN build.

scripts._comment: From repo root: `npx expo export --platform web` produces dist/. Copy/symlink it to desktop/web-build, then run these.
